entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: A remote Celtic-inspired plane with a day aspect (Lorwyn) and a night aspect (Shadowmoor) that now exist side by side.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The day aspect of the plane, a small temperate forested world in perpetual midsummer.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The night aspect of the plane, a world of perpetual night suffused with wild magic.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The faerie queen who used the Great Aurora to control the plane; defeated, but her consciousness lingers.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: A Mornsong elf duplicate created by Oona with a piece of her soul, who gained sentience, helped defeat her and became queen of the fae.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A shapeshifter created by Oona as her first avatar who turned against her and fled.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: An elf in the coalition against Oona, made immortal by Maralen and trained by Colfenor in yew magic.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A flamekin of the coalition who bonded with a greater elemental.

entities.name: Brigid
entities.description: A kithkin of the coalition against Oona.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: A merrow of the coalition against Oona.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: A treefolk of the coalition who trained Rhys in yew magic.

entities.name: Nath
entities.description: A cruel elvish hunter slain by Rhys and interred in a wild grove.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: The incarnation of Lorwyn and one of the plane's twin worldsouls.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The incarnation of Shadowmoor and one of the plane's twin worldsouls.

entities.name: Knollspine
entities.description: A Shadowmoor dragon that slumbered beneath Spinerock Knoll.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The magical convergence orchestrated by Oona that shifted the plane between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor every 300 years.

entities.name: Age of Oona
entities.description: The era when Oona controlled the plane's cycle of aspects.

entities.name: Pendulum Year
entities.description: The turbulent period after Oona's defeat when the plane began to fuse and borders shifted unpredictably.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: An event that healed the Multiverse of accumulated time rifts and disrupted the Great Aurora cycle.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion that destroyed the plane's power balance and forced species to cooperate.

entities.name: Eclipsed realms
entities.description: Pockets of neither light nor shadow that form where borders grind together and slowly turn travelers into calciforms.

entities.name: Reliquaries of Dawn and Twilight
entities.description: Relics made from pieces of Eirdu and Isilu that let the bearer keep form and memory when crossing aspects.

entities.name: Crescent of Morningtide
entities.description: An ancient relic empowered by a great elemental that could bridge the gap between aspects without changing.

entities.name: Elves of Lorwyn
entities.description: The cruel elves who are the de facto rulers of Lorwyn; decimated and compleated in the invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: New Phyrexia's invaders, who compleated elves and used new tactics against kithkin and faeries.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: The Gilt-Leaf capital city where the untainted elves made a stand against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Spinerock Knoll
entities.description: A dragon-shaped mountain that housed Knollspine and is now home to flamekin hoping to become dragons.

events.summary: Oona uses the Great Aurora to control the plane by manipulating its celestial cycle, alternating it every 300 years.
events.quote: used the Great Aurora to grant herself control of the plane by manipulating its celestial cycle

events.summary: The Great Mending disrupts the cycle, and Oona fears she may be affected by the Great Aurora.
events.quote: This continued until the cycle was disrupted in 4520 after the Great Mending

events.summary: Oona creates Oko as a vessel for her memories, but he turns against her and flees.
events.quote: a shapeshifter named Oko who turned his inherited intellect against her

events.summary: Oona creates Maralen and instills her with a piece of her own soul.
events.quote: and instilled the imposter with a piece of her own soul

events.summary: Maralen gains sentience and joins others to investigate Oona.
events.quote: banded together with others from across Lorwyn to investigate Oona and the effect she was having on the plane

events.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane into Shadowmoor, a coalition including Maralen and Rhys defeats Oona.
events.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys

events.summary: Oona's body is destroyed but her consciousness remains, determined to reclaim her power.
events.quote: Though Oona was defeated and her body was destroyed, her unforgiving consciousness remained

events.summary: Maralen becomes queen of the fae and binds Rhys to her, granting him immortality.
events.quote: Maralen took on the mantle of queen of the fae and bound herself to Rhys, granting him immortality

events.summary: The Pendulum Year begins as the plane fuses and pockets of Lorwyn sprout in Shadowmoor.
events.quote: Across Shadowmoor, pockets of Lorwyn sprouted up in the darkness

events.summary: Eirdu and Isilu emerge to control the plane's auroras, bringing forty years of peace.
events.quote: The twin worldsoul of the plane had emerged again to control the ebb and flow of the plane's auroras

events.summary: After the Age of Oona, the elves tighten their grip and cull eyeblights.
events.quote: Eyeblights were heavily culled, with some boggart communities dwindling to extinction

events.summary: The Phyrexian invasion nearly decimates the Lorwyn elves, whose dominion becomes a network of power for the Phyrexians.
events.quote: the Lorwyn elves that had once terrorized the denizens of Lorwyn were nearly decimated

events.summary: Untainted elves ally with the other species and make a stand at Lys Alana.
events.quote: they were finally able to gain ground and make a stand at Lys Alana

events.summary: Shadowmoor's boggarts form the vanguard against the invaders and suffer massive casualties.
events.quote: The boggarts formed the vanguard, riding their cavalry into the enemy lines and gutting them from within

events.summary: The Shadowmoor kithkin lead the last charge that destroys the invaders.
events.quote: it was the isolationist Shadowmoor kithkin that led the last charge to destroy the invaders

events.summary: In the current age the Lorwyn elves' empire dwindles, letting other species gain footholds.
events.quote: the empire of the Lorwyn elves has dwindled in power
